dialogues.jp:
窓辺に寄りかかりながら、室内に流れる音色に
耳を傾ける。
dialogues.en: Hitting break time, Mako walks toward me.
dialogues.text: Hitting break time, Mako walks toward me.

dialogues.jp:
もう何十回となく聴かされた曲だけど、たまに、
ふと気まぐれで聴き入ったりすることがある。
dialogues.en: "You must be tired."
dialogues.text: "You must be tired."

dialogues.jp:
初めの頃も、そんなに練習する必要はないので
は――と思っていたけど、今はもっと上手い。
dialogues.en:
I don't have anything like a towel or a drink to give her.
But I give her a sympathetic word for her work instead.
dialogues.text:
I don't have anything like a towel or a drink to give her.
But I give her a sympathetic word for her work instead.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "How was our performance?"
dialogues.text: "How was our performance?"

dialogues.jp: 休憩に入り、眞子が俺の所に歩いてくる。
dialogues.en: "I guess you guys don't need to practice any more."
dialogues.text: "I guess you guys don't need to practice any more."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どうだった？」
dialogues.en: "Ha ha, maybe."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha, maybe."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「もう練習しなくてもいいんじゃないか？」
dialogues.en:
"But we're gonna have to keep practicing until the last
minute."
dialogues.text:
"But we're gonna have to keep practicing until the last
minute."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「はは、まあね」
dialogues.en:
"It's like a race. If we relax our attention right before
the finish line, people behind us will overtake us."
dialogues.text:
"It's like a race. If we relax our attention right before
the finish line, people behind us will overtake us."

dialogues.jp:
さすが、いくつもの大会で入賞しているだけの
ことはある。言葉の響きが違う。
dialogues.en:
They aren't known as the team that has won prizes in several
competitions for nothing. She sounds different.
dialogues.text:
They aren't known as the team that has won prizes in several
competitions for nothing. She sounds different.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あっとと……。ごめん、つまらないこと言っ
　ちゃったね」
dialogues.en: "Oops... Sorry to say such silly things to you."
dialogues.text: "Oops... Sorry to say such silly things to you."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そうでもないけどな」
dialogues.en: "Oh no, not at all."
dialogues.text: "Oh no, not at all."

dialogues.jp: 最近、本音でこういう言葉がこぼれる。
dialogues.en:
Recently, I've been showing her my honest feelings like
this.
dialogues.text:
Recently, I've been showing her my honest feelings like
this.

dialogues.jp:
「そう言えば、萌先輩に俺たちのこと説明した
　のか？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, did you explain our situation to Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, did you explain our situation to Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ううん……まだ」
dialogues.en: "No... not yet."
dialogues.text: "No... not yet."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、忘れたのか」
dialogues.en: "Did you forget about it?"
dialogues.text: "Did you forget about it?"

dialogues.jp: まあ、別に急ぐこともないけど。
dialogues.en: Well, there is no reason to rush.
dialogues.text: Well, there is no reason to rush.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「今度、言っておくから」
dialogues.en: "I'll tell her next time."
dialogues.text: "I'll tell her next time."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「でも、お姉ちゃんドジだからなぁ。うっかり
　口を滑らしちゃうかも」
dialogues.en: "But she's always slipping up. She might blurt it out."
dialogues.text: "But she's always slipping up. She might blurt it out."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それは……否定しきれないところがあるな」
dialogues.en: "Well... that's undeniable."
dialogues.text: "Well... that's undeniable."

dialogues.jp:
わざと言うことなど萌先輩に限ってありえない。
｛・・・・・・／ついうっかり｝、忘れてしまうのだ。
dialogues.en:
She would never say the truth intentionally. But she forgets
thing 'carelessly'.
dialogues.text:
She would never say the truth intentionally. But she forgets
thing 'carelessly'.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: また急に真面目な顔をして。
dialogues.en: What's that, such a serious expression all of a sudden?
dialogues.text: What's that, such a serious expression all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あたしたちのこと、結構ウワサになってきて
　るみたいなんだけど……知ってた？」
dialogues.en:
"It seems like the word about us is getting around... Did
you know?"
dialogues.text:
"It seems like the word about us is getting around... Did
you know?"

dialogues.jp:
今朝、音楽室に踏み入れた時の雰囲気で、何と
なく気づいていた。
dialogues.en: "Uh... Yeah, sort of."
dialogues.text: "Uh... Yeah, sort of."

dialogues.jp:
なんだかんだ言って、今朝の眞子の待ち伏せは、
目立ってたってことだろう。
dialogues.en:
When I came into the music room this morning, I kind of got
that feeling.
dialogues.text:
When I came into the music room this morning, I kind of got
that feeling.

dialogues.jp: それとも杉並がうまく情報操作してくれたか。
dialogues.en:
No matter what someone says, Mako's waiting in ambush this
morning might have been noticeable.
dialogues.text:
No matter what someone says, Mako's waiting in ambush this
morning might have been noticeable.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、ようやく成果が出てきたってところかな」
dialogues.en: "Our attempts are finally getting rewarded."
dialogues.text: "Our attempts are finally getting rewarded."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね。でも……」
dialogues.en: "Yes. But......"
dialogues.text: "Yes. But......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「せっかくだから、もっとウワサを広めてみな
　い……？」
dialogues.en: "Why don't we spread the word about us more......?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't we spread the word about us more......?"

dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 室内のざわめきが、サアッ――と引いていく。
眞子の顔が、目の前にドアップである。
dialogues.en: The noise of the people in the room goes all quiet.
dialogues.text: The noise of the people in the room goes all quiet.

dialogues.jp:
背伸びをして俺の胸に両手をそえ、互いの身体
が軽く接する。
dialogues.en: Mako's face appears in front of my face.
dialogues.text: Mako's face appears in front of my face.

dialogues.jp: なかば無意識に眞子の腰に手を回す。
dialogues.en:
She puts her hands on my chest while stretching herself, and
our bodies touch each other slightly.
dialogues.text:
She puts her hands on my chest while stretching herself, and
our bodies touch each other slightly.

dialogues.jp:
柔らかな眞子の唇の感触ではなく、甘い吐息が
口元にかかっている。
dialogues.en: (Her boobs are...... Fairly big?)
dialogues.text: (Her boobs are...... Fairly big?)

dialogues.en: I slip my arms around her waist, half unconsciously.
dialogues.text: I slip my arms around her waist, half unconsciously.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ……練習に戻るね」

微妙な距離を保っていた唇が、触れる寸前で目
の前から離れていく。
dialogues.en: (Her lips are......)
dialogues.text: (Her lips are......)

dialogues.jp: 眞子の腰に回していた手が、虚しく宙を抱く。
dialogues.en:
And then I feel on my lips her sweet breath, not her soft
lips.
dialogues.text:
And then I feel on my lips her sweet breath, not her soft
lips.

dialogues.jp: やり過ぎだっての。
dialogues.en: She was just -- making a pretense of kissing.
dialogues.text: She was just -- making a pretense of kissing.

dialogues.jp: 「後のことも考えろよ……」
爆発しそうな胸を押さえて、ため息をつく。
dialogues.en: "Okay... I'm going back to the practice."
dialogues.text: "Okay... I'm going back to the practice."

dialogues.jp: （思わず、焦っちまったじゃないか）
dialogues.en:
When my lips were almost touching hers, she backed away from
me.
dialogues.text:
When my lips were almost touching hers, she backed away from
me.

dialogues.jp:
まだ胸の鼓動が早鐘のように、俺の体内で鳴り
響いている。
dialogues.en:
My arms that were around Mako's waist are now holding the
air.
dialogues.text:
My arms that were around Mako's waist are now holding the
air.

dialogues.jp: ……って、あれ？
なんで、俺はこんなに興奮しているんだろう？
dialogues.en: That was too much.
dialogues.text: That was too much.

dialogues.jp: ひとりで首を傾げてしまう。
dialogues.en: "Think of the consequences......"
dialogues.text: "Think of the consequences......"

dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、微妙に意識してた？　俺」
dialogues.en: I release a sigh, holding my unsteady breast.
dialogues.text: I release a sigh, holding my unsteady breast.

dialogues.jp:
演奏の始まった室内で、俺の呟きが吸い込まれ
ていった……。
dialogues.en: My muttering dies away when the performance begins again...
dialogues.text: My muttering dies away when the performance begins again...

dialogues.jp: ◆演技のキス◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
いつものように、音楽部の眞子の練習に付き合
う。
dialogues.en:
Leaning on the window, I'm listening to the music being
played in the room.
dialogues.text:
Leaning on the window, I'm listening to the music being
played in the room.

dialogues.jp:
眞子が言うには、俺と眞子のことが大分噂になっ
てきているらしい。
dialogues.en:
Although I've heard the same music dozens of times,
sometimes I pay attention to it for no reason.
dialogues.text:
Although I've heard the same music dozens of times,
sometimes I pay attention to it for no reason.

dialogues.jp:
「もっとウワサを広めてみないか」という眞子
の顔が俺に近づいてきて……。
dialogues.en:
At first, I thought they didn't have to practice too much --
but they've improved their quality level even more.
dialogues.text:
At first, I thought they didn't have to practice too much --
but they've improved their quality level even more.

dialogues.jp: キスのフリだった。
